'''Hubert Rodney Withers''' (September 21, 1932 &ndash; February 25, 2015)<ref>{{Cite web|url = http://www.radres.org/news/220956/H.-Rodney-Withers--1932--2015.htm|title = H. Rodney Withers ( 1932- 2015) - Radiation Research Society (RADRES)|website = www.radres.org|access-date = 2016-03-03|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20170809022347/http://www.radres.org/news/220956/H.-Rodney-Withers--1932--2015.htm|archive-date = 9 August 2017|url-status = dead}}</ref> was an Australian [[radiation biology|radiation biologist]] and physician. He made many contributions to the fields of radiobiology and clinical [[radiation therapy]], but he is best known for his work on post-radiation tissue repair and the effects of ionizing radiation on normal tissues.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://faculty.bioscience.ucla.edu/institution/personnel?personnel_id=8335 |title=PhD Programs in Bioscience |publisher=Faculty.bioscience.ucla.edu |date= |access-date=2012-10-05 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714224242/http://faculty.bioscience.ucla.edu/institution/personnel?personnel_id=8335 |archive-date=2014-07-14 }}</ref>

Withers was born in Queensland, Australia. He received his medical degree from the [[University of Queensland]] and his PhD and DSc from the [[University of London]]. He worked at the [[Louis Harold Gray|Gray Laboratory]] in England, the [[National Cancer Institute]], the [[M.D. Anderson Cancer Center]], the [[Prince of Wales Hospital, Sydney]], and at [[UCLA]] where he served as Professor and Chair of the Department of Radiation Oncology.<ref>Medical Physics / Volume 25 / Issue 12</ref>

==Awards and honors==
Withers received numerous awards and honors for his research including:

*[[Enrico Fermi Award]]<ref>{{cite web|author=The Enrico Fermi Award |url=http://science.energy.gov/fermi/award-laureates/1990s/elkind-withers/ |title=Mortimer M. Elkind and H. Rodney Withers, 1996 &#124; U.S. DOE Office of Science (SC) |publisher=Science.energy.gov |date=2011-03-14 |accessdate=2012-10-05}}</ref>
*[[Kettering Prize]]
*[[Order of Australia|Officer of the Order of Australia]]<ref>{{cite web |url=https://honours.pmc.gov.au/honours/awards/883482 |title=It's an Honour - Honours - Search Australian Honours |publisher=Itsanhonour.gov.au |date=1998-01-26 |accessdate=2012-10-05 |archive-date=15 July 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150715044614/http://www.itsanhonour.gov.au/honours/honour_roll/search.cfm?aus_award_id=883482&search_type=simple&showInd=true |url-status=live }}</ref>
*Gray Medal<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.icru.org/images/pdf/withers.pdf|title=Seventh ICRU-Gray Medal Winner|publisher=Icru.org|accessdate=2012-10-05|archive-date=24 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924032632/http://www.icru.org/images/pdf/withers.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>
